verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents outbound webhook callbacks on transcription jobs: applications receive completion updates via webhooks, and the changelog adds a webhook callback when a job is canceled. This is a real programmatic event-subscription mechanism for the job lifecycle. Missing for 10: documentation of how webhooks are registered (per-job vs. account-level), a full event catalog beyond completion and cancellation, delivery guarantees such as retries and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
